author: EmuCore - Hub
title: POCO X7 Pro 5G Test AetherSX2 Emulator PS2 Resolusi Tinggi Lancar + Gamepad | Aether SX2 Blackhawk
summary: DI GEAR records a thirty-game AetherSX2 run on the Dimensity 8400 Ultra POCO X7 Pro, including DS4 setup, graphics configuration and a reported peak temperature near 50°C for sustained-performance context.

blocks.text: The thirty-six-minute Indonesian test supplies unusually dense device context. It begins with HyperOS 2 on Android 15, shows emulator settings and a DualShock 4 connection, then moves through thirty titles such as Chaos Legion, Devil May Cry 3, Shadow of the Colossus, Tekken 5 and The Warriors. The specification block identifies twelve gigabytes of RAM, UFS 4.0 storage and an Immortalis-G720 MC7 GPU. A stated temperature approaching 50°C makes thermal behavior part of the evidence rather than an invisible footnote.

The description mixes a phone review with affiliate purchase and gamepad links, and its positive marketing language is not independent laboratory measurement. Resolution can vary between titles, recorded footage adds overhead, and displayed speed during one scene cannot certify a complete game. High surface or sensor temperature also needs a defined reading method before cross-device comparison. Use the chapters to locate demanding cases, then reproduce them with current drivers, fixed ambient conditions, explicit resolution and frame-time logging instead of generalizing from the SoC name alone.
